flagged.title: Data Compression: Huffman and Run-Length Encoding
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that the 7-bit encoded string 0010110 for 'EETA' is '8 bits' (F1), which would lead students to calculate incorrect bit counts in exam questions.

mark_affecting.quote: That gives us 0 0 1 0 1 1 0. That's just 8 bits.
